editor.name: Pi Claude
editor.runtime: official Claude Code CLI on raspberrypi51 (claude_cli.py)

inherited.problem: 原文给出的拒绝增加配水的理由只有一条：逆风可能拖长航程。“缺水是人所能承受的最严酷的匮乏”在原文中是描述口渴的一般性感慨，紧接的是盐水加剧口渴，并不是拒绝预支的理由。稿件把它放在冒号之后、与风向理由并列（中文用“而”、英文用“and”连接），写成了拒绝的依据。
inherited.suggestion: 把“缺水是……最严酷的匮乏”从理由句中拆出，单独成句放在描述口渴处。中文改为：……航程拖长许多天。原文感叹，缺水是人所能承受的最严酷的匮乏。英文改为：…lengthen the voyage by many days. Lack of water, the account adds, is the severest privation men can be condemned to endure.

contamination.brief_line: 方向：这篇讲在象岛上定下的一个求援决策：为什么把目标定在八百英里外的南乔治亚而不是更近的福克兰，谁去谁留、带什么丢什么、走之前怎么交代留守的人 (SOUTH-EL1-E4)(SOUTH-EL1-E7)(SOUTH-EL1-E13)(SOUTH-EL1-E17)。看点是把一个胜算很小的选项对全队讲清楚、让人自愿跟从，并且愿意承担拒绝病号上船的代价 (SOUTH-EL1-E6)(SOUTH-EL1-E10)(SOUTH-EL1-E12)。不要写成英雄赞歌，不要用“他当然会成功”的口吻，也不要把拒绝病号上船写成一句冷酷或高尚的道德判断 (SOUTH-EL1-E12)。
- 粮食只够全队按足额吃五个星期，减量可撑三个月，海兽可能不来，于是定为每天一顿热食 (SOUTH-EL1-E2)。
- 几名队员的健康和精神状况令人担心，一名队员双脚冻伤、医生说不动手术就保不住脚趾 (SOUTH-EL1-E1)。
- 判断必须有人乘船出海求援，而且不能拖 (SOUTH-EL1-E3)。
- 福克兰的斯坦利港更近，但要顶着常年西北风用一条脆弱的小船抢风航行；南乔治亚八百英里外，但在西风带内，东岸各捕鲸站可能找到人，冰情允许的话一个月可望往返 (SOUTH-EL1-E4)。
- 算过最坏情形：岛上的人风险不会因此增加，冬天少六张嘴，船上只带六人一个月的口粮；而象岛不会有任何人来搜寻他们 (SOUTH-EL1-E5)。
- 向全队讲清利害：五月中合恩角以南是世界上最暴虐的水域，出海只为援助的急迫需要 (SOUTH-EL1-E6)。
- Worsley 和 Wild 都要求同行；指定 Wild 留守全队，并交代万一求援失败，春季带人去 Deception Island (SOUTH-EL1-E7)。
- 选 Worsley 随行，理由是他定位快而准，尤其在困难情况下 (SOUTH-EL1-E8)。
- 征求志愿者，但作者写明心里其实已有名单 (SOUTH-EL1-E9)。
- Crean 原本要留下当 Wild 的帮手，他恳求上船，与 Wild 商量后带上他 (SOUTH-EL1-E10)。
- 有人不够强壮，有人不是熟练水手，虽然近几个月的经历也算得一点水手资格 (SOUTH-EL1-E11)。
- 有人提议带上病号让他尽快得到温暖和庇护，被否掉：健康的人在船上都难活，重病躺舱底的人熬不过必定遇到的坏天气 (SOUTH-EL1-E12)。
- 最后定下 Worsley、Crean、McNeish、McCarthy、Vincent 和作者六人 (SOUTH-EL1-E13)。
- 木匠年过五十、身体不算好，但懂帆船、手快 (SOUTH-EL1-E14)。
- 他把另一条船的桅杆横放作龙骨加强，用箱盖和雪橇板搭骨架，冻硬的帆布在油炉上一寸寸烤开再缝成覆罩；覆罩看着像舞台布景，但事后证明确实顶用 (SOUTH-EL1-E15)。
- 看到浮冰随时可能合拢，决定次日出发；在象岛的最后一夜又冷又不舒服 (SOUTH-EL1-E16)。
- 上岸交代留守的 Wild，写明几乎把整个局面和行动范围都交给他自行判断，并当面说信任他、把队伍托付给他 (SOUTH-EL1-E17)。
- 启航时留在岸上的人挥手欢呼 (SOUTH-EL1-E18)。
- 船上做饭要三个人：一人护灯、两人护锅 (SOUTH-EL1-E19)。
- 出海第六天船因结冰失去弹性，扔掉备用桨和两条湿透冻硬的睡袋，剩下四条，其中一条留给有人彻底垮掉时应急 (SOUTH-EL1-E20)。
- 缆绳断、海锚丢失，只能在大风里升帆顶风 (SOUTH-EL1-E21)。
- 出海第七天见太阳，观测显示已走三百八十多英里，接近南乔治亚的一半 (SOUTH-EL1-E22)。
- 第十一天夜里遇到前所未见的巨浪，船被抛起又挣脱出来 (SOUTH-EL1-E23)。
- Vincent 一周来已不再承担船员工作，作者写明无法解释他的垮掉：他身体本来是船上最强的 (SOUTH-EL1-E24)。
- 水要减到每人每天半品脱，有人恳求预支第二天的水被拒绝，因为风向一变航程会拖长 (SOUTH-EL1-E25)。

必须写明的不确定性：这套记录只有当事人一个史源，是他事后的第一人称自述 (SOUTH-EL1-E3)。文中的对话，例如把队伍托付给 Wild 的那句交代，是记述性的，未必逐字 (SOUTH-EL1-E17)；Crean 恳求随行也是同样情况 (SOUTH-EL1-E10)。不要替人物写心理：作者说看队员时“信心增加”只是自述，不是当时可核实的心理记录 (SOUTH-EL1-E13)；Vincent 为何垮掉作者自己说无法解释 (SOUTH-EL1-E24)。原文按出海后的天数记事，没有公元年份，文章里只用原文的天数与月份，不做换算 (SOUTH-EL1-E20)(SOUTH-EL1-E22)(SOUTH-EL1-E23)。距离、口粮、水的数字都照原文写，如两个距离、走了三百八十多英里、半品脱 (SOUTH-EL1-E4)(SOUTH-EL1-E5)(SOUTH-EL1-E22)(SOUTH-EL1-E25)。原文为扫描识别文本，个别字词有讹误，引用时照原文写法。

现代应用：资源有限、外部不会主动来救的小团队，要不要派人冒险出去求援、派谁去、谁留下看家、物资砍到什么程度、什么时候必须定下出发时点 (SOUTH-EL1-E2)(SOUTH-EL1-E3)(SOUTH-EL1-E5)(SOUTH-EL1-E13)(SOUTH-EL1-E16)；以及负责人临走前如何把决定权和责任一起交出去，说清楚失败时的后手 (SOUTH-EL1-E7)(SOUTH-EL1-E17)。

issues.problem: “一条脆弱的小船/one fragile boat”和“胜算很小的路/a long-odds voyage”在证据中都没有依据。证据只说航程危险极大，没有给出胜算，也没有说船“脆弱”（只有覆罩被称为 flimsy decking）。这两个说法与已知污染 K1（“胜算很小的选项”）和 K5（“一条脆弱的小船”）的措辞一致。

evidence.quote: all hands knew that the perils of the proposed journey were extreme

issues.proposed: 中文改为“一条小船……走一条危险极大的路”；英文改为“one small boat … a voyage whose perils were extreme”。
issues.rationale: 删去证据外的“脆弱”和“胜算很小”，中文改为“一条小船”“一条危险极大的路”，英文改为 one small boat 和 a voyage whose perils were extreme。

issues.problem: 英文通篇称叙述者为“the captain”，但证据没有给出这一职衔。证据中他只以第一人称出现，是作出决定、交出指挥权的人（Wild 随后 remaining in full command）。用一个证据外的具体官职，容易让读者误认人物。此问题适用于全文所有英文“the captain”。

evidence.quote: who was remaining in full command

issues.proposed: 英文全文把“the captain”改为“the leader”（与中文“队长”对应），或改为“the narrator”。
issues.rationale: 证据没有给出 captain 这一职衔。所有英文字段里的 the captain 都改为 the leader，与中文“队长”对应；对应中文字段同步给出，内容不变。

issues.problem: “于是全队定为每天只吃一顿热食/So the whole party went onto…”把决定写成燃料状况的直接后果，并改成了无主语的被动句。原文的写法是：作者先初步估量了形势，然后由他本人作出决定。

evidence.quote: after making a preliminary survey of the situation, I decided that the party must be limited to one hot meal a day

issues.proposed: 中文改为“初步估量形势后，队长决定全队每天只吃一顿热食”；英文改为“After a preliminary survey of the situation, he decided the party must be limited to one hot meal a day.”
issues.rationale: 去掉“于是/So”造成的直接因果，恢复原文写法：他先初步估量形势，再亲自作出决定。

issues.problem: 英文引语后紧接“The conclusion was forced on him.”，与引语内容重复。
issues.proposed: 删去英文末句，或改为“in his words”引出原句。

issues.problem: “一支船队”在中文里指多条船组成的船队，与原文 a boat party（乘一条船的一队人）和英文译法不一致。

evidence.quote: A boat party might make the voyage

issues.proposed: 改为“一队人乘船”。
issues.rationale: “一支船队”改为“一队人乘船”，与原文 boat party 一致。

issues.problem: “冬天还少了六张嘴/six fewer mouths”在证据中没有依据，原文只说 fewer mouths。“六张嘴”来自已知污染 K6。

evidence.quote: There would be fewer mouths to feed during the winter

issues.proposed: 中文改为“冬天要吃饭的嘴也少了”；英文改为“fewer mouths to feed through the winter”。
issues.rationale: 删去证据外的“六张嘴/six”，中文改为“冬天要吃饭的嘴也少了”，英文改为 fewer mouths to feed。

issues.problem: “正因为如此/So”把必须详细论证说成上一段最坏情形计算的结果。原文给出的原因是全队都知道航程危险极端。英文还删去了“since”这层因果连接。

evidence.quote: The case required to be argued in some detail, since all hands knew that the perils of the proposed journey were extreme

issues.proposed: 删去“正因为如此/So”；英文改为“The case had to be argued in some detail, since everyone knew the journey's perils were extreme.”
issues.rationale: 删去“正因为如此/So”。英文恢复 since 引出的原因：全队都知道航程危险极端。

issues.problem: “船横倒进涌里”容易被读成船翻覆。原文只说船突然横落进浪谷。

evidence.quote: the boat suddenly fell off into the trough of the sea

issues.proposed: 改为“船突然横落进浪谷”。
issues.rationale: 中文改为“船突然横落进浪谷”，避免读成翻覆；英文同步补上 suddenly 和 of the sea。

issues.problem: 原文不增加配水的理由只有一条，即逆风可能拖长航程。“缺水是最严酷的匮乏”在原文里是描述口渴的一般感慨，稿件却用“而/and”把它并列进冒号后的拒绝理由。

evidence.quote: I dared not permit the 175 SOUTH allowance of water to be increased since an unfavourable wind might drive us away from the island and lengthen our voyage by many days
Lack of water is always the most severe privation that men can be condemned to endure

issues.proposed: 把这句感慨从理由句中拆出单独成句。中文：“……航程拖长许多天。原文感叹，缺水是人所能承受的最严酷的匮乏。”英文：“…lengthen the voyage by many days. Lack of water, the account adds, is the severest privation men can be condemned to endure.”
issues.rationale: 拒绝增水的理由只保留逆风可能拖长航程一条。“缺水是最严酷的匮乏”拆出来单独成句，标明是原文的感叹。

issues.problem: “留下的人在冬天少六张嘴/six fewer mouths”在证据中没有依据（原文只说 fewer mouths），沿用了已知污染 K6。

evidence.quote: There would be fewer mouths to feed during the winter

issues.proposed: 中文改为“少了几张要吃饭的嘴”；英文改为“fewer mouths to feed”。
issues.rationale: 删去“六张嘴/six”，中文改为“少了几张要吃饭的嘴”，英文改为 fewer mouths to feed。

issues.problem: “风险的下限/The floor of the risk”方向说反了。原文算的是最坏情形（at worst），即对留守者损害的上界，不是下限。

evidence.quote: at worst the venture would add nothing to the risks of the men left on the island

issues.proposed: 中文改为“最坏情形被算成：也不会给留下的人增加风险”；英文改为“The worst case was calculated as adding nothing…”
issues.rationale: “风险的下限/floor”方向说反了，改为“最坏情形被算成/The worst case was calculated as”。

issues.problem: 本段声明“数字都照原文：八百英里/eight hundred miles”，但原文写的是 over 800 miles，稿件丢了“多/over”。

evidence.quote: South Georgia was over 800 miles away

issues.proposed: 改为“八百多英里/over eight hundred miles”。
issues.rationale: 补回原文的“多/over”，改为“八百多英里/over eight hundred miles”；英文同时按 F2 改为 the leader。

issues.problem: 中文漏掉了天气不稳定一项，英文有“unsettled weather”，中英不一致。

evidence.quote: The weather then is unsettled

issues.proposed: 中文改为“天气不稳，天色阴沉，大风几乎不停”。
issues.rationale: 中文补上“天气不稳”，与英文 unsettled weather 和原文一致。

issues.problem: 原文给出的拒绝增加配水的理由只有一条：逆风可能拖长航程。“缺水是人所能承受的最严酷的匮乏”在原文中是描述口渴的一般性感慨，紧接的是盐水加剧口渴，并不是拒绝预支的理由。稿件把它放在冒号之后、与风向理由并列（中文用“而”、英文用“and”连接），写成了拒绝的依据。
issues.rationale: 问题成立。原文不增加配水的唯一理由是逆风拖长航程，“缺水最严酷”是对口渴的一般感慨，稿件把它写成了拒绝依据。与 F9 相同。

issues.problem: 原文说两位医生担心手术“将是必要的”，中英文都弱化成“可能需要/might be necessary”，削弱了原文的判断。

evidence.quote: the two doctors feared that an operation would be necessary

issues.proposed: 中文改为“两位医生担心必须动手术”；英文改为“the two doctors feared an operation would be necessary”。
issues.rationale: 原文为“would be necessary”，中英文原先弱化为“可能需要/might be necessary”。现中文改为“两位医生担心必须动手术”，英文改为“feared an operation would be necessary”，与证据一致；该字段其余文字未动。

issues.problem: 英文保留了原文的“pathetic little group”，中文只写“站成一小群”，漏掉“可怜”这一层，中英不一致。

evidence.quote: made a pathetic little group on the beach

issues.proposed: 中文改为“在海边站成可怜的一小群”。
issues.rationale: 中文补上“可怜的”，改为“在海边站成可怜的一小群”，与英文“pathetic little group”及原文一致。英文本已准确，按中英同步规则原样给出完整文字。

edits.after: 足额口粮只够五个星期，一条小船，六个名额。队长要说服全队走一条危险极大的路，还要否掉带病号上船的提议，并在开船前把整支队伍交到留守者手里。

edits.before: Full rations for five weeks, one fragile boat, six places. The captain had to talk the whole party into a long-odds voyage, veto a proposal to take a sick man along, and hand the stranded party over to the man staying behind before the boat pulled away.
edits.after: Full rations for five weeks, one small boat, six places. The leader had to talk the whole party into a voyage whose perils were extreme, veto a proposal to take a sick man along, and hand the stranded party over to the man staying behind before the boat pulled away.

edits.before: On Elephant Island the food would last the whole party five weeks at full ration. Cut back, it could be spread over three months, and would probably be supplemented to some extent by seals and sea-elephants — but the captain dared not count on that with full confidence. The animals seemed to have deserted the beach and winter was near. Their stocks included three seals and two and a half skins with the blubber attached, and they were mainly dependent on blubber for fuel. So the whole party went onto one hot meal a day.
edits.after: On Elephant Island the food would last the whole party five weeks at full ration. Cut back, it could be spread over three months, and would probably be supplemented to some extent by seals and sea-elephants — but the leader dared not count on that with full confidence. edits.after: 出海的风险明摆着。队长算过最坏情形：这趟冒险不会给留在岛上的人增加任何风险，冬天要吃饭的嘴也少了；船上只带六人一个月的口粮——「for if we did not make South Georgia in that time we were sure to go under」，一个月到不了南乔治亚，就是死路。还有一条让他格外看重的考虑：象岛上根本不会有任何搜寻队来找他们。

edits.before: The hazards of the ocean were plain, but the captain had priced the worst case. At worst the venture would add nothing to the risks of the men left on the island — six fewer mouths to feed through the winter — and the boat needed no more than a month's provisions for six, "for if we did not make South Georgia in that time we were sure to go under". And one consideration weighed with him: there was no chance at all of any search being made for them on Elephant Island.
edits.after: The hazards of the ocean were plain, but the leader had priced the worst case. At worst the venture would add nothing to the risks of the men left on the island — there would be fewer mouths to feed through the winter — and the boat needed no more than a month's provisions for six, "for if we did not make South Georgia in that time we were sure to go under". And one consideration weighed with him: there was no chance at all of any search being made for them on Elephant Island.

edits.before: 航程中有一次，遇上了队长二十六年海上经历中从未见过的巨浪，与多日来那些白浪翻卷的大浪完全不同。他高喊大家抓紧。船被像软木塞一样抛起、向前甩出，灌进半船水，在重击下颤抖；所有人拼命用随手抓到的容器掏水，十分钟后才觉得船重新有了生命。Vincent 在过去一周已不再是积极的船员，队长写明难以解释他的垮掉——他是船上体格最强壮的人之一，年轻，在北海拖网船上干过，本该比 McCarthy 更能吃苦，而 McCarthy 没那么强壮，却总是乐呵呵的。淡水减到每人每天半品脱。带上船的冰块早已用完，装船时一只水桶在浪里被撞裂，渗进了一些海水，喝的水发咸，渴得更厉害；队长不肯增加配给，有人恳求预支第二天的水，也被拒绝：万一风向不利，船可能被吹离海岛，航程拖长许多天，而缺水是人所能承受的最严酷的匮乏。

edits.before: At one point came a wave beyond anything the captain had met in twenty-six years at sea — a mighty upheaval of the ocean, quite apart from the white-capped seas that had been their tireless enemies for many days. He shouted for everyone to hold on: "It's got us!" The boat was lifted and flung forward like a cork, half-full of water and shuddering under the blow; the men baled with the energy of men fighting for life, and after ten minutes of uncertainty felt her renew her life beneath them. Vincent had for the past week ceased to be an active member of the crew, and the captain could not easily account for his collapse: physically one of the strongest men in the boat, young, with service on North Sea trawlers, he should have borne hardship better than McCarthy, who was not so strong but always happy. The daily water allowance was cut to half a pint a man. The lumps of ice taken aboard were long gone, and the breaker had been slightly stove in during loading, letting in some sea-water, so the brackish water sharpened the thirst; the captain would not raise the allowance or let anyone draw against the morrow's, however he was begged — should the wind turn unfavourable, it might drive them away from the island and lengthen the voyage by many days, and lack of water is the severest privation men can be condemned to endure.

issues.problem: 英文通篇称叙述者为“the captain”，但证据没有给出这一职衔。证据中他只以第一人称出现，是作出决定、交出指挥权的人（Wild 随后 remaining in full command）。用一个证据外的具体官职，容易让读者误认人物。此问题适用于全文所有英文“the captain”。

evidence.quote: who was remaining in full command

issues.proposed: 英文全文把“the captain”改为“the leader”（与中文“队长”对应），或改为“the narrator”。

issues.problem: “于是全队定为每天只吃一顿热食/So the whole party went onto…”把决定写成燃料状况的直接后果，并改成了无主语的被动句。原文的写法是：作者先初步估量了形势，然后由他本人作出决定。

evidence.quote: after making a preliminary survey of the situation, I decided that the party must be limited to one hot meal a day

issues.proposed: 中文改为“初步估量形势后，队长决定全队每天只吃一顿热食”；英文改为“After a preliminary survey of the situation, he decided the party must be limited to one hot meal a day.”

issues.problem: 英文引语后紧接“The conclusion was forced on him.”，与引语内容重复。
issues.proposed: 删去英文末句，或改为“in his words”引出原句。

issues.problem: “一支船队”在中文里指多条船组成的船队，与原文 a boat party（乘一条船的一队人）和英文译法不一致。

evidence.quote: A boat party might make the voyage

issues.proposed: 改为“一队人乘船”。

issues.problem: “冬天还少了六张嘴/six fewer mouths”在证据中没有依据，原文只说 fewer mouths。“六张嘴”来自已知污染 K6。

evidence.quote: There would be fewer mouths to feed during the winter

issues.proposed: 中文改为“冬天要吃饭的嘴也少了”；英文改为“fewer mouths to feed through the winter”。

issues.problem: “正因为如此/So”把必须详细论证说成上一段最坏情形计算的结果。原文给出的原因是全队都知道航程危险极端。英文还删去了“since”这层因果连接。

evidence.quote: The case required to be argued in some detail, since all hands knew that the perils of the proposed journey were extreme

issues.proposed: 删去“正因为如此/So”；英文改为“The case had to be argued in some detail, since everyone knew the journey's perils were extreme.”

issues.problem: “船横倒进涌里”容易被读成船翻覆。原文只说船突然横落进浪谷。

evidence.quote: the boat suddenly fell off into the trough of the sea

issues.proposed: 改为“船突然横落进浪谷”。

issues.problem: 原文不增加配水的理由只有一条，即逆风可能拖长航程。“缺水是最严酷的匮乏”在原文里是描述口渴的一般感慨，稿件却用“而/and”把它并列进冒号后的拒绝理由。

evidence.quote: I dared not permit the 175 SOUTH allowance of water to be increased since an unfavourable wind might drive us away from the island and lengthen our voyage by many days
Lack of water is always the most severe privation that men can be condemned to endure

issues.proposed: 把这句感慨从理由句中拆出单独成句。中文：“……航程拖长许多天。原文感叹，缺水是人所能承受的最严酷的匮乏。”英文：“…lengthen the voyage by many days. Lack of water, the account adds, is the severest privation men can be condemned to endure.”

issues.problem: “留下的人在冬天少六张嘴/six fewer mouths”在证据中没有依据（原文只说 fewer mouths），沿用了已知污染 K6。

evidence.quote: There would be fewer mouths to feed during the winter

issues.proposed: 中文改为“少了几张要吃饭的嘴”；英文改为“fewer mouths to feed”。

issues.problem: “风险的下限/The floor of the risk”方向说反了。原文算的是最坏情形（at worst），即对留守者损害的上界，不是下限。

evidence.quote: at worst the venture would add nothing to the risks of the men left on the island

issues.proposed: 中文改为“最坏情形被算成：也不会给留下的人增加风险”；英文改为“The worst case was calculated as adding nothing…”

issues.problem: 本段声明“数字都照原文：八百英里/eight hundred miles”，但原文写的是 over 800 miles，稿件丢了“多/over”。

evidence.quote: South Georgia was over 800 miles away

issues.proposed: 改为“八百多英里/over eight hundred miles”。

issues.problem: 中文漏掉了天气不稳定一项，英文有“unsettled weather”，中英不一致。

evidence.quote: The weather then is unsettled

issues.proposed: 中文改为“天气不稳，天色阴沉，大风几乎不停”。

inherited.rationale: 问题成立。原文不增加配水的唯一理由是逆风拖长航程，“缺水最严酷”是对口渴的一般感慨，稿件把它写成了拒绝依据。与 F9 相同。

evidence.quote: since an unfavourable wind might drive us away from the island and lengthen our voyage by many days
